{{Quote|Look out!|The woman warns Kyle Katarn of impending doom|<ref name="DF2" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who resided on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]</ref> was a '''Rebel sympathizer'''. She supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and their endeavors,<ref name="DFG" /> who during 5 ABY had become known as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While minding herself near a staffed control panel, a [[Unidentified Rodian bounty hunter (Nar Shaddaa)|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] decided to lay a trap for [[Kyle Katarn]], a man looking for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], who was hired by 8t88, was going to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Katarn when he came close. When Katarn did eventually make his way to the woman's area, she attempted to warn Katarn of the impending attack.<ref name="DF2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Katarn avoided the Rodian's attacks, and subsequently killed him. The Rebel sympathizer thanked Katarn for keeping her out of harms way.<ref name="DF2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The woman first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a civilian who appeared during the game's fifth level. If the player was to kill her, they would stray to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]]. In addition, killing the Rodian is not vital to beating the game in any way.<ref name="DF2" /> The fact that she was a Rebel sympathizer was revealed in the game's [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], which was written by [[Rick Barba]]. This article assumes that the player does not kill the woman, but does kill the Rodian.
